summary: Phase F7 verification (centralised Trash, Localization/Locale module, full Media Library with folders + WebP/thumbnail variants + usage tracking, server-side HTMLPurifier sanitisation, flat-translatable 422 guard, security headers/CSP) plus landing + admin regression. New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/pytest/test_phase_f7_trash_locale_media_security.py: 28/28 passing. Browser (Playwright) verified: admin login (non-2FA), technology soft-delete -> /admin/trash chip 'Technologies' -> restore -> reappears in list; force-delete dialog + permanent removal; Editor sees NO force-delete buttons and API returns 403; localization page (make-default EN <-> ID, toggle active, default cannot be deactivated -> toast 'The default locale cannot be deactivated.', no delete button on default, create 'jv' -> soft delete -> Trash 'Locales' chip -> force delete, coverage table x/y per module incl. 0/n for new locale); media library (create folder, upload into folder, thumbnail rendered from *_thumb.webp naturalWidth=480, details modal saves alt/caption + folder move with success toast, 'Used by: Not used anywhere', folder rename with slug update, empty-folder delete, non-empty folder blocked 409); landing page renders all 9 sections in dark/light and ID/EN with ZERO console errors and ZERO CSP violations (Google Fonts + /api/storage images load), contact form stores lead visible in Inbox; /admin/dashboard, /admin/portfolio/projects, /admin/settings/seo, /admin/inbox, /admin/media, /admin/trash, /admin/settings/localization all load with zero console errors. Two pre-existing F4 tests now fail because backend .env has APP_LOCALE=en (admin 'content' block resolves EN instead of the CMS default locale id). All test data cleaned up and `php artisan db:seed --force` was run; Trash and media folders are empty again.

minor.issue: /app/backend/.env sets APP_LOCALE=en, and HasTranslations::translate() falls back to app()->getLocale(), so the admin resources' resolved `content` block returns ENGLISH even though the CMS default locale is `id` (health reports default_locale=id, public endpoints correctly return ID). Reproduces failures in the pre-existing suite: test_phase_f4_hero_about.py::TestHeroSection::test_show_seeded_content and ::TestAboutSection::test_show_seeded_content (assert content.headline == translations.id.headline -> 'The Person' != 'Orang di Balik'). Fix by setting APP_LOCALE=id (requires `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`) or by resolving admin content through Locale::defaultCode() instead of the app locale. There is also no middleware that maps Accept-Language/?locale to app()->setLocale() for admin routes.

usage() uses raw DB::table() without a whereNull('deleted_at') filter, so SOFT-DELETED (trashed) records still count as references. Verified: set a media file as cover of a project, soft-deleted that project -> usage still reports Projects=1 and force delete returns 409 'still used by Projects', i.e. the file can never be purged while the referencing record sits in Trash. Decide intentional or filter out trashed rows.
Force deleting a locale does not remove the *_translations rows written for that locale code (no FK to locales.code), leaving orphan translation rows after a locale is purged.

HTMLPurifier is configured with Cache.DefinitionImpl = null, which disables the definition cache and re-builds the HTML definition on the first purify of every PHP worker request cycle (measurable latency on rich-text saves). Prefer a writable Cache.SerializerPath instead.

ui_bugs.component: Admin route guard (/admin/settings/localization with Editor role)
ui_bugs.issue: Editor (no locales.view permission) can navigate to the URL and gets an empty content area with two silent 403 XHRs in console — no 'access denied' state, no redirect. Same pattern likely applies to every permission-gated page reachable by URL.

issues: Still-open issue from iteration_10: the outlined/stroked headline word ('BUSINESS' in EN / 'ANDA' in ID) is nearly invisible on the light background — very low contrast.

action_items: Set APP_LOCALE=id in /app/backend/.env (or resolve admin translated content via Locale::defaultCode()) so admin GET /admin/about & /admin/hero return the ID copy; then re-run tests/pytest/test_phase_f4_hero_about.py (2 failures).
Decide on MediaService::usage() counting soft-deleted references (currently blocks force delete forever while the referencing record is in Trash).
Add a permission-denied UI state (or redirect) for admin pages a role cannot view — Editor currently sees a blank page plus 403s on /admin/settings/localization.
Purge *_translations rows for a locale when it is force-deleted.
Improve light-theme contrast of the stroked hero word (still open from iteration_10).
critical_code_review_comments: next.config.ts CSP uses script-src 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval', which largely defeats CSP as an XSS control. Since the sanitiser is the other half of this hardening story, consider Next.js nonce-based CSP (middleware + strict-dynamic) at least for the /admin subtree.

BaseFormRequest::getValidatorInstance() invokes rules() a second time via container->call() (parent already built them) — for requests with DB-backed rules this doubles that work; cache the rules array in a property.

TrashController::index() always queries all 23 modules (each up to 200 rows + translations eager load) even when ?module= is set, because counts are needed; use SELECT COUNT(*) per module for the chips and only hydrate rows for the selected module.

Locale::defaultCode() uses Cache::rememberForever with invalidation only on saved/deleted events; LocaleController::clearOtherDefaults() uses a mass Query Builder update() which does NOT fire model events — the cache stays correct today only because the promoted locale is saved afterwards. Add an explicit Cache::forget in clearOtherDefaults.
app/admin/(panel)/media/page.tsx is 697 lines and mixes folder sidebar, uploader, grid, details modal and dialogs — split into components before it crosses the 700-line threshold.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate limits dominate test flakiness: login is 5/min per email+IP and admin API 120/min per user. The new F7 suite uses a RetrySession that backs off on 429; older suites do NOT, so run ONE phase file at a time with ~70s between runs, otherwise you see mass 429 'errors on setup' (43 such errors in the combined run were purely throttling, not defects). Useful facts: admin About is a singleton at /api/v1/admin/about (NOT /admin/about-sections/{id}); technologies require both name and slug (lowercase-hyphen only); translatable PATCH must send the COMPLETE translations.{locale} object (partial payloads 422 on required title/question); flat translatable keys now correctly 422 with 'Send {field} inside translations.{locale} instead.'; trash force-delete dialog testid is trash-force-delete-dialog with button 'Delete permanently'; media folder testids use the folder SLUG (e.g. media-folder-filter-qa-folder). Next.js revalidate webhook needs header x-revalidate-secret (not a body field) and is only reachable at http://localhost:3000/api/revalidate.
rca_of_the_issue: APP_LOCALE=en in the reconstructed /app/backend/.env is the root cause of the 2 F4 failures: HasTranslations::translate() defaults to app()->getLocale(), there is no middleware mapping Accept-Language/?locale for admin routes, so admin resources build their `content` block from the EN translation while the CMS default locale (locales table / health endpoint) is id. Public endpoints are unaffected because they resolve through Locale::defaultCode(). Reproduce: GET /api/v1/admin/about -> content.headline 'The Person' while translations.id.headline is 'Orang di Balik'. Mitigation: APP_LOCALE=id + restart backend, or resolve admin content with Locale::defaultCode().
